comparison.objective: Compresses and locks a spring cartridge; candidate fractures and recovers tangs from already-installed HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Axial spring compression and lock engagement differ from narrow-mandrel alignment, separately delivered hammer impact, notch fracture, and loose-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Compression and locked retention are title-supported; no body, specs, force, or lock thresholds are available. Candidate requires four contact-driven fractures, four contained tangs, and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both demand force control, but elastic compression/latching and irreversible notch fracture with fragment accountability are different central abilities.
